title: Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)
description:
Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview


As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities


  • Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel , ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Database Development:

Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.

  • API Development and Integration:

Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.

  • Security Compliance:

Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA , by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities


  • Mentor backend developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Support the team in resolving technical challenges and ensure consistent development standards across the team.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in the agile development process, contributing to sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.
  • Collaborate with the design team to refine the platform's user interface and experience, implementing responsive and intuitive front-end functionalities using modern JavaScript frameworks.


Competencies / Requirements


  • Technical Expertise:

Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL . Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git .

  • Experience:

At least 6+ years of experience in backend development , with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.

  • Problem-Solving Skills:

Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

  • Communication Skills:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

  • Attention to Detail:

A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits


  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Líder de Operações de Varejo
description:
Somos uma startup de IA criada para o varejo - e estamos procurando profissionais de varejo.


A STOREE.AI é uma startup em crescimento que leva IA para lojas físicas de forma prática e pé no chão.


Ajudamos organizações de varejo a conduzirem melhor as operações do dia a dia - comunicação, tarefas, prioridades, acompanhamentos e KPIs - usando uma IA que funciona como um ótimo gestor.


Você não precisa ter background técnico.

Sem experiência com software. Sem conhecimento em IA.


Se você entende como o varejo realmente funciona - pessoas, pressão, execução e tomada de decisão - você já tem exatamente o que buscamos.


Nós construímos a tecnologia.

Você traz a experiência de varejo.


Essa é a parceria.


O que fazemos:


A STOREE.AI é usada diariamente por mais de 100 redes de lojas no mundo.


A plataforma fica no centro das operações da loja e ajuda gestores a:


  • Comunicar com clareza com lojas e equipes
  • Transformar prioridades em tarefas executáveis
  • Fazer follow-up de forma automática e consistente
  • Acompanhar performance e KPIs em tempo real
  • Treinar e orientar equipes no trabalho do dia a dia, não em apresentações


Ela é familiar para quem é do varejo, porque foi construída em torno de como os bons gestores já operam - só que mais rápido, mais claro e em escala.


Por que a experiência de varejo importa:


Nossa plataforma é poderosa, mas varejo não é “tamanho único”.


O que importa para uma rede de moda não é o mesmo que importa para um supermercado.

O que um líder de VM procura é diferente do que HR/RH ou Operações procuram.


Por isso, não estamos buscando vendedores tradicionais.


Estamos buscando profissionais seniores de varejo que consigam:


  • Entender as necessidades reais de uma organização de varejo
  • Ajudar a moldar o “gestor de IA” certo para cada rede
  • Falar a linguagem do varejo, não buzzwords
  • Conduzir conversas com credibilidade e profundidade


Isso é desenvolvimento de negócios baseado em entendimento, não em “pitch”.


O que você vai fazer na prática:


  • Construir relacionamentos com organizações de varejo relevantes
  • Iniciar conversas usando nossas ferramentas de IA (treinamento completo incluído)
  • Mostrar como a STOREE.AI se encaixa na realidade específica deles
  • Conduzir o processo ou passar para nosso time central quando necessário
  • Influenciar a direção do produto - você será nosso olhar de varejo dentro da empresa


Você não vai “vender software”.

Você vai conectar experiência com soluções reais.


Para quem é:


Líderes seniores de varejo, incluindo:


  • Gerentes de loja, distrito e regional
  • Líderes de HQ em operações, RH, treinamento, VM, CX ou excelência no varejo
  • Qualquer pessoa que já liderou equipes de varejo e quer dar o próximo passo


Se você já pensou:


“A tecnologia não entende de verdade o que acontece nas lojas” - nós concordamos.


Foi exatamente por isso que criamos a STOREE.AI.


O que oferecemos:


  • Treinamento completo - não é necessário background técnico
  • Trabalho remoto com horários flexíveis
  • Remuneração por comissão, com possibilidade de efetivação full-time
  • Chance de entrar antes de uma grande escala global
  • Tecnologia real, já funcionando no campo


Isso não é um emprego.


É uma segunda carreira.


De comandar lojas para ajudar a definir como as lojas serão comandadas.


Quer começar direto? Inicie o processo aqui.

title: Teacher Assistant
description:
Position: Teacher Assistant

Section : Early Childhood Education and Elementary

Application deadline: March 15, 2026

Start date: Immediate.


Main responsibilities: Care for and guide students, fostering their social, emotional, academic, and moral development. Support specific needs related to child care and learning. Supervise students during recess, arrival, and dismissal times. Assist in the development of proposed educational activities. Assist the Moral Education teacher in the development and implementation of planned lessons and activities focused on values, character, and community-building. Provide substitution support when necessary. 


Requirements: Bilingual in Portuguese and English. Teaching degree in Education (Pedagogy). Experience working with children in the Early Childhood Education and Elementary age group (2-11). Punctuality, responsibility, and flexibility. Ability to work collaboratively with a positive and cooperative attitude. Strong alignment with the school’s vision, mission, and values, especially its commitment to moral education and holistic development.


About the Company: School of the Nations is an international, nonprofit K-12 school inspired by the Bahá’í teachings, School of the Nations was founded with the primary purpose of unlocking human potential through academic excellence, the cultivation of moral and spiritual qualities, and a lifelong commitment to service for the betterment of society. School of the Nations is an authorized International Baccalaureate (IB) School offering the Primary Years (PYP) and the Diploma (DP) Programs. Accredited as an international school by NEASC, our strategic development is guided by the ACE Learning Ecosystem 2.0.


Shared Understanding of High-Quality Learning

High-quality learning at the School of the Nations is rooted in our aspiration to release human potential through academic excellence, moral and spiritual qualities, and a lifelong commitment to service, empowering learners to develop the capacities of heart and mind to understand the world and contribute to the betterment of society.


In an inclusive, diverse, and globally-minded community, our students develop cognitive, creative, physical, spiritual, and social-emotional abilities; learners are agents of their own learning, actively setting goals, engaging in rich and complex challenges, and documenting growth; they demonstrate depth of understanding, collaboration, reflection, and multiple perspectives across disciplines.


Learning happens through a coherent, inquiry-based curriculum grounded in spiritual principles and practical applications, with diverse assessment and feedback guiding meaningful growth.


School of the Nations is an equal-opportunity employer. We encourage people with disability to apply.

Principais responsabilidades: Cuidar e orientar os alunos, promovendo seu desenvolvimento social, emocional, acadêmico e moral. Oferecer suporte em substituições quando necessário.


Requisitos: Bilíngue em português e inglês. Licenciatura em Pedagogia. Experiência com crianças na faixa etária da Educação Infantil e do Ensino Fundamental I (2 a 11 anos). Pontualidade, responsabilidade e flexibilidade. Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa, com atitude positiva e cooperativa. Forte alinhamento com a visão, missão e valores da escola, especialmente com seu compromisso com a educação moral e o desenvolvimento integral.


Sobre a empresa: A Escola das Nações é uma instituição internacional, privada, sem fins lucrativos, coeducacional e duolinguística (inglês e português), localizada em Brasília. Oferecemos um programa educacional que vai do berçário ao 12º ano e somos credenciados internacionalmente pela NEASC e, nacionalmente, pela Secretaria de Educação do Distrito Federal. Com estudantes e colaboradores de 30 países e origens diversas, promovemos um ambiente de aprendizado inclusivo que incentiva a cidadania global e valoriza a diversidade.


Compreensão Compartilhada de Aprendizagem de Alta Qualidade

A aprendizagem de alta qualidade na Escola das Nações está enraizada em nossa aspiração de liberar o potencial humano por meio da excelência acadêmica, do desenvolvimento de qualidades morais e espirituais e de um compromisso contínuo com o serviço, capacitando os alunos a desenvolverem as capacidades do coração e da mente para compreender o mundo e contribuir para o aprimoramento da sociedade.


Em uma comunidade inclusiva, diversa e com visão global, nossos estudantes desenvolvem habilidades cognitivas, criativas, físicas, espirituais e socioemocionais; os alunos são agentes do próprio aprendizado, definindo metas ativamente, engajando-se em desafios ricos e complexos e documentando seu crescimento; demonstram profundidade de compreensão, colaboração, reflexão e a capacidade de considerar múltiplas perspectivas entre as diferentes áreas do conhecimento.


A aprendizagem acontece por meio de um currículo coerente e baseado na investigação, fundamentado em princípios espirituais e aplicações práticas, com avaliações diversificadas e feedback que orientam um desenvolvimento significativo.


A Escola das Nações é um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades. Incentivamos pessoas com deficiência a se candidatarem.

Na J17, estamos construindo o futuro do ecossistema financeiro e buscamos um(a) Analista de Onboarding para ser a ponte entre nossos produtos inovadores e nossos parceiros. title: Mainframe System Engineer
description:
Mainframe System Engineer

Location – Brazil Remote



Job Overview:


We are seeking an experienced Mainframe System Engineer to join our team and provide operational, consultancy, and migration support in a complex IBM Z environment. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in mainframe operations, storage administration , and migration projects involving IBM and CA products. This role requires strong technical proficiency, problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams to ensure seamless system operations and migrations.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage and support mainframe operations, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Provide consultancy and technical assistance for migration projects
  • Implement and configure IBM storage solutions such as DFSMSrmm , DFSMShsm , and related advanced audit and reporting tools.
  • Assist with installation and configuration of IBM OMEGAMON for Storage and other monitoring tools.
  • Develop and maintain JCL scripts, REXX, and Assembler programs for automation and operational efficiency.
  • Utilize TSO and ISPF for system management and troubleshooting.
  • Collaborate with storage administrators to assess migration impacts and provide training/documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with system standards and best practices for SMP/E and z/OS environments.


Mandatory Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in mainframe operations, service, or support roles.
  • Technical Skills:
  • Proficiency in TSO , ISPF , and JCL .
  • Ability to write REXX and Assembler programs.
  • Experience with DFSMSrmm and/or CA-1 Tape Management System .
  • Hands-on experience with IBM tools such as:
  • IBM OMEGAMON for Storage
  • IBM Advanced Audit and Reporting for DFSMShsm
  • IBM Advanced Catalog Management (ACM)
  • IBM Advanced Allocation Management (AAM)
  • Ability to migrate tools, including the following, within mainframe systems
  • CA-1 to DFSMSrmm migration (configuration, installation, JCL code, runtime parameters).
  • CA FAVER to IBM Advanced Catalog Management migration (customized JCL creation).
  • IBM Global Resource Serialization (GRS) migration (training, PARMLIB member creation, operational considerations).
  • CA Allocate to IBM Advanced Allocation Management migration (installation, configuration, training).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for documentation and stakeholder interaction.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of IBM Z system operation and configuration, including SMP/E .
  • Familiarity with competing products and migration strategies.
  • Experience with Storage Administration on IBM Z .
  • Migration experience across IBM and CA products with ability to create customized JCL and runtime parameters.

title: Human Resources Business Partner Manager (HRBP)
description:
Who we are

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan, a global giant in the delivery sector, and we’re on a bold mission: to revolutionize food and consumer goods delivery around the world. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.”

With innovation and technology at our core, Keeta is expanding rapidly — with over 1,000 employees worldwide — and you can be part of this global journey.


About the position

We are looking for a HRBP Manager to join our HR team in Brazil .

You will report directly to the HR Lead in Brazil and collaborate with a lean, high-impact team responsible for different business lines and strategic projects.

This is a hands-on role, ideal for someone comfortable operating in high-growth, 0→1 environments , balancing strategy, execution, and stakeholder management.


Job Responsibilities:

Organizational Optimization:

  • Assist business leaders in building an efficient organizational structure for Keeta, facilitating alignment of goals within the management team.
  • Regularly conduct organizational diagnostics to identify key issues and challenges, and proactively follow up on solutions.

Talent Development:

  • Utilize talent review, development, and co-creation facilitation methods to focus on the recruitment, training, development, and advancement of key talents.
  • Provide strong talent pipeline support and help build talent succession plans for business departments.

Culture Implementation:

  • Drive the implementation and promotion of corporate culture and values within the department.
  • Regularly organize employee engagement and care activities to communicate company philosophy and values, strengthening team cohesion and morale.

Strategic Partnership:

  • Gain deep understanding of the business strategy of the international team.
  • Participate in the entire process from strategy formulation to execution, and develop tailored HR plans to achieve both short- and long-term business objectives.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above, with over 3 years of HR experience; experience supporting international teams is preferred.
  • Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills; able to communicate efficiently with international teams and partners.
  • Strong logical thinking and learning ability, solid HR fundamentals, self-driven, curious, and able to work under pressure.

Job Highlights:

  • Opportunity to participate in the building of an international team, broaden your horizons, and work with global talent.
  • Fast-growing business with great personal development potential; work alongside a professional and high-caliber HR team.


Nice to have

  • Experience working in Chinese companies or multicultural, Asia-influenced environments.


Interested in joining Keeta?

Check out our open positions! When applying, your information will be securely stored and may be shared with Keeta and its global affiliates.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior
description:
Olá!


Estamos em busca de profissionais Sênior de Engenharia de Dados para atuar de forma estratégica e técnica, sendo responsável por projetar, desenvolver e otimizar sistemas e arquiteturas de dados complexas.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados batch e streaming;
  • Construir e evoluir arquiteturas modernas (data lakes, data warehouses, lakehouses);
  • Desenvolver soluções escaláveis em ambientes cloud;
  • Realizar modelagem de dados complexa, garantindo performance e sustentabilidade;
  • Implementar práticas de CI/CD e automação de deploy;
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com times de dados, analytics e áreas de negócio;
  • Apoiar e revisar tecnicamente entregas de outros profissionais.

Conhecimentos e habilidades essenciais:

  • Experiência sólida em Engenharia de Dados;
  • Domínio de Python e SQL avançado;
  • Experiência com Spark (transformação, performance tuning e debugging);
  • Vivência com ferramentas de orquestração (dbt, Airflow, AWS Glue ou similares);
  • Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas e modelagem (incluindo SCD);
  • Atuação prévia em ambientes cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure);
  • Conhecimento em práticas de DevOps e automação de deploy;
  • Inglês Avançado/Fluente (conversação, leitura e escrita).


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Kafka, Flink e arquiteturas de streaming;
  • Conhecimento em formatos como Iceberg e Parquet;
  • Vivência com governança, qualidade e segurança de dados;
  • Experiência em ambientes de alta complexidade técnica.

Formação:

  • Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas.

Informações importantes:

  • Nosso formato de trabalho é híbrido, estamos localizados em Curitiba/Pr.

• Busca crescimento profissional em um ambiente empreendedor.

- Excelente comunicação formal, verbal e escrita.

- Organização para registrar contatos e follow-ups.

- Interesse em área comercial/negócios.

- Proatividade para pesquisa de leads.


Desejável

- Cursando ou ter formação técnica ou superior em Administração, Marketing, Publicidade, Comunicação, Eventos ou áreas relacionadas;

- Boa familiaridade com Pacote Office, ferramentas do Google (Google Workspace) e pesquisa na internet;



Benefícios:

 Flexibilidade de horário (com metas e entregas definidas).

  • Experiência com serviços cloud computing
  • Familiaridade com arquiteturas de sistemas, pipelines de dados e boas práticas de integração de APIs (REST, GraphQL)

title: Expansão Comercial - Captação de Recursos
description:
A Domus Finanças e Investimentos está com uma posição aberta para captação de recursos junto a uma fintech brasileira que opera como Instituição de Pagamento regulamentada, especializada em antecipação salarial para servidores públicos por meio de tecnologia proprietária e um modelo inovador de arranjo fechado supervisionado pelo Banco Central.


A empresa desenvolveu um ecossistema financeiro que conecta servidores públicos, comércio local e administrações municipais, promovendo inclusão financeira e dinamização da economia local.


Para sustentar a expansão de sua operação e ampliar sua capacidade de funding, buscamos Executivos Comerciais focados em captação de investidores , responsáveis por desenvolver relacionamento com investidores pessoa física e pessoa jurídica interessados em oportunidades estruturadas no mercado financeiro.


A posição é direcionada a profissionais com perfil empreendedor, capacidade de relacionamento e forte orientação comercial.


Principais Responsabilidades

O profissional atuará no desenvolvimento comercial da base de investidores da empresa.

Entre suas principais atividades destacam-se:

  • Prospecção ativa de investidores pessoa física e pessoa jurídica
  • Condução de reuniões comerciais e apresentações de oportunidades de investimento
  • Estruturação e fechamento de contratos de investimento
  • Desenvolvimento de relacionamento de longo prazo com investidores
  • Expansão do share of wallet dos clientes ao longo do tempo
  • Gestão e organização das atividades comerciais por meio de CRM
  • Manutenção de rotina comercial consistente voltada à geração de novos negócios.



Perfil do Profissional

Busca-se um perfil com forte capacidade de relacionamento e experiência em ambientes comerciais ligados ao mercado financeiro.

Entre os requisitos desejáveis:

  • Experiência prévia no relacionamento com investidores ou interessados em investimentos
  • Conhecimentos básicos de mercado financeiro e estruturação de investimentos
  • Perfil comercial ativo, com capacidade de geração de oportunidades
  • Organização para gestão de pipeline e acompanhamento de clientes
  • Capacidade de comunicação e construção de confiança com investidores

A posição tende a atrair profissionais oriundos de áreas como:

  • Assessoria de investimentos
  • Consultoria financeira
  • Mercado financeiro e bancário
  • Consultoria empresarial
  • Profissionais com networking qualificado (advogados, contadores, executivos)



Estrutura de Trabalho

A função foi desenhada para profissionais que buscam autonomia e flexibilidade na atuação comercial.

  • Modelo de contratação PJAtuação 1
  • 00% remotaFlexibili
  • dade de horários
  • Dedicação mínima sugerida de 3 horas diárias para atividade comercial
  • Possibilidade de reuniões presenciais com investidores quando necessário



    • Remuneração

    A remuneração é totalmente orientada à geração de negócios.

    • Modelo 100% comissionadoComissão
    • recorrente sobre os investimentos captadosPercentua
    • l acima da média praticada no mercadoPotencial
    • de geração de renda recorrente com crescimento da base de investidores.



      • Diferenciais da Oportunidade

      Entre os principais diferenciais da posição destacam-se:

      • Fintech com estrutura institucional e operação regulamentada
      • Operação alinhada às normas do Banco Central
      • Ambiente com auditoria e governança institucional
      • Oportunidade de crescimento junto à expansão nacional da empresa
      • Possibilidade de formação rápida de carteira de investidores
      • Plano de progressão profissional dentro da estrutura comercial



      Quem Deve se Interessar Pela Oportunidade

      Esta posição tende a ser especialmente atrativa para profissionais com perfil comercial e networking consolidado, tais como:

      • Assessores de investimentos
      • Consultores financeiros independentes
      • Contadores e advogados com relacionamento empresarial
      • Executivos do mercado financeiro
      • Profissionais que desejam desenvolver uma carteira própria de investidores.



      Abrace essa oportunidade de ter a possibilidade de transformar sua carreira e sua vida.

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack + IA
description:
Desenvolvedor Fullstack & AI Specialist (AI-Native Engineer)

Estamos em busca de um talento que saiba unir a solidez da arquitetura de software tradicional com a agilidade das ferramentas de AI Development .


O que buscamos (Perfil Técnico)

1. Fundamentos Sólidos:

  • Domínio profundo de Arquitetura de Software e boas práticas de programação.
  • Experiência comprovada em ecossistemas Fullstack: Laravel/Next.js  e React/Vue .


2. Domínio de Ferramentas AI-Native:

  • Maestria no uso das principais ferramentas de desenvolvimento com IA do mercado: Claude Code, AntiGravity, Codex  e correlatos.
  • Habilidade em estruturar projetos \"AI-first\", organizando diretórios e fluxos pensados para a colaboração.


3. Engenharia de Contexto e Prompting:

  • Especialista em delegar tasks para a IA através de prompts estruturados e arquivos .md especialistas (Memory Bank, Cursor Rules, etc.).


4. Arquitetura de Agentes:

  • Experiência prática no desenvolvimento, treinamento e manutenção de automações e agentes verticais (Single ou Multi-agent systems ).


Requisitos Imprescindíveis

  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência real  em desenvolvimento de software antes da ascensão das ferramentas de IA generativa. Precisamos de alguém que saiba o \"por quê\" das coisas e consiga revisar códigos gerados por IA com olhar crítico (manutenibilidade, performance, padrões de projeto) e técnico.


Diferenciais

  • Mentalidade de automação extrema.
  • Fluência em arquiteturas baseadas em APIs e microsserviços.
  • Capacidade de transitar entre o código manual e o código assistido com alta performance.


Candidatou-se?  Deixe um comentário ou envie seu portfólio/GitHub focado em projetos que utilizam agentes de IA!

title: UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer
description:
UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer


About the Role

We are looking for a UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer to help improve the performance of a large-scale digital commerce platform. This role focuses on identifying friction in critical customer journeys and delivering usability improvements that directly impact conversion.


You will own the Usability workstream, partnering closely with product and analytics teams to analyze user behavior, uncover drop-off points, and design improvements across key transactional flows such as cart, checkout, and payment.


This role is ideal for a designer who combines strong UX thinking with analytical rigor and enjoys working in fast-moving consulting environments where rapid insights and quick wins are highly valued.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead usability analysis across critical customer journeys including product discovery, cart, checkout, and payment.
  • Conduct funnel analysis to identify friction points and conversion drop-offs throughout the purchase process.
  • Partner with product and analytics teams to analyze quantitative data such as conversion rates, abandonment points, and user behavior patterns.
  • Map end-to-end customer journeys to identify quick wins and usability improvements that can drive immediate conversion gains.
  • Design and prototype improvements to transactional flows, focusing on reducing friction and simplifying the purchasing experience.
  • Present insights and design recommendations to stakeholders, clearly tying usability improvements to measurable business impact.
  • Work within a fast-paced consulting team delivering iterative improvements across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in UX design or product design
  • Strong experience with data-driven design approaches, including funnel analysis and conversion optimization
  • Ability to collaborate with product and analytics teams to interpret quantitative data and translate insights into UX improvements
  • Experience mapping end-to-end user journeys and identifying usability improvements
  • Proven experience redesigning transactional flows such as cart, checkout, or payment experiences
  • Strong problem-solving and research skills
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Comfort working in fast-paced consulting environments with tight delivery timelines


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with A/B testing frameworks and experimentation programs
  • Background designing for marketplace platforms or high-traffic e-commerce products
  • Experience in consulting or agency environments with frequent stakeholder presentations
  • Familiarity with qualitative usability testing methods, including user interviews and moderated testing


This role offers the opportunity to combine UX design and analytics to drive measurable improvements in customer experience and platform performance. If you enjoy solving complex usability challenges and turning data into impactful design decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

description:

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!

Responsabilidades:

  • Implementar funcionalidades em Apex (triggers, services, batch/queueable/schedulable), garantindo bulkification, testes e respeito aos limites da plataforma.
  • Desenvolver Lightning Web Components (LWC) com arquitetura limpa, performance, consumo de dados via LDS/wire e chamadas @AuraEnabled.
  • Construir e manter integrações (REST/SOAP): callouts com Named Credentials, autenticação (OAuth/JWT), tratamento de erros e observabilidade (logs/monitoramento).
  • Atuar no ecossistema de Service Cloud & Digital Engagement (Chat, WhatsApp, Bots), integrando fluxos de atendimento e automações.
  • Realizar troubleshooting avançado (debug logs, trace flags, Event Monitoring) e otimizações de performance/consultas.

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência com LWC (JS moderno, componentização, comunicação com Apex).
  • Vivência com Digital Engagement (Chat/Messaging/WhatsApp), incluindo implementação técnica e integração com processos de atendimento.
  • Integrações via API REST/SOAP em Apex (Named Credentials, serialização JSON/XML, tratamento de exceções).
  • Troubleshooting e análise de logs em ambientes produtivos e sandboxes.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado de governor limits e estratégias de otimização.
  • Prática com Salesforce DX e Git (pull requests, code review).
  • Certificações: Platform Developer I

CLT, salário a combinar+ benefícios.

100% remoto.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

title: Cybersecurity Project Manager
description:
The Project Manager in our cybersecurity/IT services division will lead the planning and execution of complex technology projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget . This role acts as a bridge between technical teams (network/security engineers, developers, analysts) and business stakeholders. The Project Manager is responsible for coordinating cross-functional efforts in a dynamic environment, often managing multiple projects or client engagements simultaneously, aligning them with strategic goals and the latest industry practices (e.g., Agile methodology, cloud deployments, security compliance ).

Key Responsibilities:

  • Project Planning & Execution: Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables for cybersecurity and IT infrastructure projects. Develop detailed project plans with timelines, milestones, and resource allocation. Manage the full project lifecycle from initiation to closure, adapting to changing requirements or priorities.
  • Team Leadership & Coordination: Lead cross-functional teams (security engineers, IT staff, developers, client representatives) to ensure collaboration and timely task completion. Assign responsibilities, oversee day-to-day project activities, and maintain team motivation and productivity in both on-site and remote/hybrid work environments .
  • Budget & Risk Management: Manage project budgets and control costs. Identify and mitigate risks and issues proactively; implement contingency plans to address potential project roadblocks or security concerns. Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards and regulations (e.g., data privacy laws, security policies) throughout project execution.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary contact for internal and external stakeholders. Provide regular project status updates, performance metrics, and risk assessments to clients, senior management, and team members. Facilitate meetings, gather feedback, and manage expectations to maintain alignment with project goals and client needs.
  • Quality Assurance & Delivery: Ensure project deliverables meet the required quality and security standards. Coordinate testing, user acceptance, and security reviews on project outputs (e.g., new system implementations, policy rollouts). Oversee documentation (project plans, reports, compliance evidence) and obtain stakeholder sign-offs.
  • Post-Project Support & Continuous Improvement: Oversee transition of completed projects to operational teams. Conduct post-mortems and lessons-learned sessions to identify improvement opportunities. Stay informed on emerging industry trends (like AI integration in project management , DevSecOps , and new collaboration tools ) to continually enhance project management practices.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education & Professional Knowledge: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business (or related field). Strong understanding of IT systems, networks, and cybersecurity fundamentals to effectively communicate with technical teams and align projects with security best practices.
  • Project Management Skills: Proven ability to manage complex IT or security projects using project management methodologies (Waterfall and Agile). Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, or Trello) for planning, tracking, and reporting. Skilled in developing project documentation and managing project scope changes.
  • Leadership & Communication: Excellent leadership and organizational skills. Demonstrated experience coordinating cross-functional teams , managing resources, and resolving conflicts. Exceptional communication skills to interface with diverse stakeholders and present project updates in a clear, concise manner.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving: Strong risk assessment, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Capacity to anticipate challenges, craft mitigation strategies, and adapt to evolving project needs. Must be detail-oriented but also able to see the big picture to ensure projects deliver strategic value.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced Knowledge: Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and regulatory standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) to integrate compliance into project plans. Understanding of modern IT trends such as cloud computing projects, digital transformation , or AI-driven solutions is a plus.
  • Industry Experience: Prior experience in an IT services or consulting environment , managing projects for external clients or within large enterprise settings. Background in network/security infrastructure projects or software development projects is advantageous.
  • Methodologies: Certifications or hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies (e.g., Certified Scrum Master) or DevOps/DevSecOps practices.

Experience Requirements:

  • Experience: 7+ years of experience in project management within the IT or cybersecurity domain. This should include successfully managing multiple full project lifecycles , with at least several projects related to IT security, networking, or software/IT infrastructure . Leadership experience in a matrixed or cross-functional team environment is essential.

Certifications:

  • Project Management Certifications: Project Management Professional (PMP) or PRINCE2 (highly preferred / required) as evidence of formal project management training and expertise.
  • Security/Technical Certifications: Certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) , Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) , or Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) are a plus, signifying an understanding of cybersecurity principles and compliance.
  • Agile/Other Certs: Additional certifications like Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or ITIL Foundation are beneficial and reflect a commitment to industry best practices.

title: UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer
description:
UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer


About the Role

We are looking for a UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer to help improve the performance of a large-scale digital commerce platform. This role focuses on identifying friction in critical customer journeys and delivering usability improvements that directly impact conversion.


You will own the Usability workstream, partnering closely with product and analytics teams to analyze user behavior, uncover drop-off points, and design improvements across key transactional flows such as cart, checkout, and payment.


This role is ideal for a designer who combines strong UX thinking with analytical rigor and enjoys working in fast-moving consulting environments where rapid insights and quick wins are highly valued.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead usability analysis across critical customer journeys including product discovery, cart, checkout, and payment.
  • Conduct funnel analysis to identify friction points and conversion drop-offs throughout the purchase process.
  • Partner with product and analytics teams to analyze quantitative data such as conversion rates, abandonment points, and user behavior patterns.
  • Map end-to-end customer journeys to identify quick wins and usability improvements that can drive immediate conversion gains.
  • Design and prototype improvements to transactional flows, focusing on reducing friction and simplifying the purchasing experience.
  • Present insights and design recommendations to stakeholders, clearly tying usability improvements to measurable business impact.
  • Work within a fast-paced consulting team delivering iterative improvements across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in UX design or product design
  • Strong experience with data-driven design approaches, including funnel analysis and conversion optimization
  • Ability to collaborate with product and analytics teams to interpret quantitative data and translate insights into UX improvements
  • Experience mapping end-to-end user journeys and identifying usability improvements
  • Proven experience redesigning transactional flows such as cart, checkout, or payment experiences
  • Strong problem-solving and research skills
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Comfort working in fast-paced consulting environments with tight delivery timelines


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with A/B testing frameworks and experimentation programs
  • Background designing for marketplace platforms or high-traffic e-commerce products
  • Experience in consulting or agency environments with frequent stakeholder presentations
  • Familiarity with qualitative usability testing methods, including user interviews and moderated testing


This role offers the opportunity to combine UX design and analytics to drive measurable improvements in customer experience and platform performance. If you enjoy solving complex usability challenges and turning data into impactful design decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta oportunidade será para atuar em uma multinacional brasileira que acelera a coevolução digital de organizações por meio de tecnologia, processos, pessoas e inteligência de dados.

Faz parte de um grupo corporativo que reúne companhias focadas em segurança da informação, gestão de identidades, CRM, billing e serviços de tecnologia para o mercado internacional .


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenhar arquiteturas de segurança para ambientes on-premises e em nuvem.
  • Avaliar riscos, mapear ameaças e conduzir práticas de Threat Modeling (ex.: STRIDE).
  • Atuar com frameworks de segurança e apoiar auditorias e compliance.
  • Integrar controles de segurança em pipelines DevSecOps (SAST, DAST, SCA, IAST).
  • Propor melhorias contínuas de postura de segurança (CSPM, CWPP).
  • Suportar times internos e stakeholders em decisões técnicas críticas.
  • Desenhar e implementar soluções IAM (SSO, MFA, PAM).
  • Colaborar em projetos globais em um ambiente dinâmico e de alto nível técnico.


O que você precisa ter

  • Inglês avançado/fluente (mandatório)
  • Domínio de frameworks: ISO 27001/27002, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, LGPD/GDPR .
  • Experiência em Cloud Security (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Conhecimento sólido em Zero Trust, microssegmentação, VPN, NGFW, WAF, IDS/IPS .
  • Vivência em AppSec & DevSecOps , com ferramentas SAST/DAST/SCA/IAST.
  • Experiência com IAM : SSO, MFA, PAM, OAuth, OIDC e SAML.
  • Habilidade em Threat Modeling e mapeamento de fluxos de dados.
  • Inglês avançado para comunicação diária.


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento para automação de segurança (Python, Go ou Java).
  • Vivência em ambientes regulados (bancário, saúde, fintechs).
  • Conhecimento em criptografia aplicada, incluindo PKI, HSM e gestão de chaves .
  • Perfil analítico, colaborativo e orientado à resolução de problemas.
  • Boa comunicação, autonomia e capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas.

description:
About Vammo

Vammo is building an accessible, resilient, and scalable clean energy network for emerging megacities, starting in Latin America. By combining electric motorcycle subscriptions with a rapidly expanding battery swap infrastructure, we make clean transportation affordable and reliable for the millions who keep cities moving.


Founded in 2022 and headquartered in São Paulo, Vammo has raised $100M from top-tier investors across the globe. Our founders and team represent an incredibly diverse and international group that is built of former executives coming from Tesla, Uber, Rappi, iFood, Loggi, Niu, Jump and others. We are all deeply motivated by the mission to decarbonize Latin America while simultaneously reducing costs for one of the region’s most vulnerable populations.


The next wave of mobility innovation will come not from San Francisco, but from São Paulo. Our operations will soon expand from Sao Paulo to cities across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, proving that real climate impact and transformative business models can be built first where the need is greatest.

The Parts Inventory Manager is responsible for managing spare parts and component inventory across multiple Vammo locations. This role ensures accurate stock control for electrical motorcycles, BBoxes, batteries, and related components.


The position leads the inventory team, maintains accurate data in the Warehouse Management System (WMS), and guarantees that physical stock matches system records through regular cycle counts and inventory audits. The role works closely with Supply Chain, Procurement, Operations, and After-Sales teams to ensure parts availability and operational efficiency.


Key responsibilities include supervising inventory operations, managing stock levels across sites, implementing inventory control processes, and ensuring reliable reporting and traceability of all parts movements.

  • Multi-site inventory management
  • Demand planning and stock level optimization
  • Process implementation and standardization
  • Cost optimization in inventory and logistics
  • Experience with motorcycle components and electronic parts.

  • Strong organizational skills
  • Problem-solving mindset
  • Attention to detail
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Communication skills
  • Process improvement mindset
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment

  • Hands-on mentality (\"mão na massa\") – willing to dive into operations when needed

O Gerente de Estoque é responsável por gerenciar o estoque de peças e componentes em diferentes locais da Vammo. Essa função garante o controle preciso do estoque de motocicletas elétricas, BBoxes, baterias e seus respectivos componentes.


A posição lidera o time de inventário, mantém informações precisas no WMS (Warehouse Management System) e garante que o estoque físico esteja alinhado com os registros do sistema por meio de contagens cíclicas e auditorias de inventário. Essa função trabalha em conjunto com as áreas de Supply Chain, Procurement, Operações e Pós-Vendas para garantir disponibilidade de peças e eficiência operacional.


As principais responsabilidades incluem supervisionar as operações de inventário, gerenciar níveis de estoque em diferentes sites, implementar processos de controle de estoque e garantir relatórios confiáveis e rastreabilidade de todas as movimentações de peças.

description:
Company Description

Pixel Breeders specializes in transforming visionary concepts into cutting-edge technology solutions tailored for startups and innovative projects. The company focuses on software development, AI-driven solutions, and technology consultancy to help clients launch, scale, and optimize their products. Our expertise lies in building scalable systems using the latest AI technologies, automation, and data-driven insights to create impactful and future-proof products. Pixel Breeders is dedicated to empowering startups and innovators by delivering custom tech solutions that drive success and open new opportunities. Collaborate with us to bring new ideas to life and shape the future of technology.


Role Description

This is an internship remote role for a UI Design Intern at Pixel Breeders. The selected candidate will assist in creating user-centered designs, building intuitive user interfaces, conducting usability testing, and collaborating with developers and product teams.   • Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and responsiveness in web and mobile design
  • Strong attention to detail, creativity, and ability to work in team collaborations
  • Good communication skills for discussing design decisions and receiving feedback

title: Visual & Brand Experience Designer
description:
Visual & Brand Experience Designer


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Visual & Brand Experience Designer to support a large-scale digital product initiative focused on modernizing the user experience of a leading marketplace platform. This role will play a key part in reimagining how customers navigate and interact with a multi-brand digital ecosystem.


You will lead the Visual Makeover & Usability workstream while also helping shape a multi-brand gallery experience that brings together multiple brands within a single marketplace environment. The ideal candidate is a highly creative product designer who can quickly move from research and benchmarking into compelling visual concepts that inspire stakeholders and guide product direction.


This is a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles, so comfort working in ambiguous environments and presenting bold ideas to senior stakeholders is essential.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and lead the visual direction for key product workstreams focused on improving usability and modernizing the marketplace interface.
  • Conduct benchmarking of leading global marketplace platforms to inform design strategy and identify best-in-class user experience patterns.
  • Develop high-fidelity visual concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate new interface directions and inspire product leadership.
  • Design and prototype a multi-brand navigation and discovery experience that enables users to seamlessly browse across brands within a unified marketplace.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to translate design ideas into clear product directions.
  • Present design concepts and rationale to senior stakeholders, helping guide decision-making around product experience and visual identity.
  • Work within a fast-moving consulting team delivering iterative design outputs across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product design, visual design, or UI design
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality interface design and visual storytelling
  • Deep understanding of e-commerce and marketplace design patterns
  • Experience analyzing and benchmarking international digital products
  • Ability to produce high-fidelity concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate bold design ideas
  • Comfort presenting conceptual work to senior leadership and stakeholders
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Ability to thrive in fast-paced consulting environments with rapid iteration cycles


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing multi-brand digital ecosystems or marketplaces
  • Familiarity with Asian marketplace and super-app UX paradigms such as those seen in Alibaba, Shopee, or Pinduoduo
  • Background working with retail, consumer products, or marketplace platforms
  • Previous experience in agency or consulting environments with fast delivery timelines


If you’re a designer who enjoys pushing visual boundaries, exploring global product patterns, and shaping the experience of large-scale digital platforms, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a high-visibility product initiative.

title: Cybersecurity Project Manager
description:
The Project Manager in our cybersecurity/IT services division will lead the planning and execution of complex technology projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget . This role acts as a bridge between technical teams (network/security engineers, developers, analysts) and business stakeholders. The Project Manager is responsible for coordinating cross-functional efforts in a dynamic environment, often managing multiple projects or client engagements simultaneously, aligning them with strategic goals and the latest industry practices (e.g., Agile methodology, cloud deployments, security compliance ).

Key Responsibilities:

  • Project Planning & Execution: Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables for cybersecurity and IT infrastructure projects. Develop detailed project plans with timelines, milestones, and resource allocation. Manage the full project lifecycle from initiation to closure, adapting to changing requirements or priorities.
  • Team Leadership & Coordination: Lead cross-functional teams (security engineers, IT staff, developers, client representatives) to ensure collaboration and timely task completion. Assign responsibilities, oversee day-to-day project activities, and maintain team motivation and productivity in both on-site and remote/hybrid work environments .
  • Budget & Risk Management: Manage project budgets and control costs. Identify and mitigate risks and issues proactively; implement contingency plans to address potential project roadblocks or security concerns. Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards and regulations (e.g., data privacy laws, security policies) throughout project execution.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary contact for internal and external stakeholders. Provide regular project status updates, performance metrics, and risk assessments to clients, senior management, and team members. Facilitate meetings, gather feedback, and manage expectations to maintain alignment with project goals and client needs.
  • Quality Assurance & Delivery: Ensure project deliverables meet the required quality and security standards. Coordinate testing, user acceptance, and security reviews on project outputs (e.g., new system implementations, policy rollouts). Oversee documentation (project plans, reports, compliance evidence) and obtain stakeholder sign-offs.
  • Post-Project Support & Continuous Improvement: Oversee transition of completed projects to operational teams. Conduct post-mortems and lessons-learned sessions to identify improvement opportunities. Stay informed on emerging industry trends (like AI integration in project management , DevSecOps , and new collaboration tools ) to continually enhance project management practices.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education & Professional Knowledge: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business (or related field). Strong understanding of IT systems, networks, and cybersecurity fundamentals to effectively communicate with technical teams and align projects with security best practices.
  • Project Management Skills: Proven ability to manage complex IT or security projects using project management methodologies (Waterfall and Agile). Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, or Trello) for planning, tracking, and reporting. Skilled in developing project documentation and managing project scope changes.
  • Leadership & Communication: Excellent leadership and organizational skills. Demonstrated experience coordinating cross-functional teams , managing resources, and resolving conflicts. Exceptional communication skills to interface with diverse stakeholders and present project updates in a clear, concise manner.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving: Strong risk assessment, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Capacity to anticipate challenges, craft mitigation strategies, and adapt to evolving project needs. Must be detail-oriented but also able to see the big picture to ensure projects deliver strategic value.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced Knowledge: Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and regulatory standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) to integrate compliance into project plans. Understanding of modern IT trends such as cloud computing projects, digital transformation , or AI-driven solutions is a plus.
  • Industry Experience: Prior experience in an IT services or consulting environment , managing projects for external clients or within large enterprise settings. Background in network/security infrastructure projects or software development projects is advantageous.
  • Methodologies: Certifications or hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies (e.g., Certified Scrum Master) or DevOps/DevSecOps practices.

Experience Requirements:

  • Experience: 7+ years of experience in project management within the IT or cybersecurity domain. This should include successfully managing multiple full project lifecycles , with at least several projects related to IT security, networking, or software/IT infrastructure . Leadership experience in a matrixed or cross-functional team environment is essential.

Certifications:

  • Project Management Certifications: Project Management Professional (PMP) or PRINCE2 (highly preferred / required) as evidence of formal project management training and expertise.
  • Security/Technical Certifications: Certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) , Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) , or Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) are a plus, signifying an understanding of cybersecurity principles and compliance.
  • Agile/Other Certs: Additional certifications like Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or ITIL Foundation are beneficial and reflect a commitment to industry best practices.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Cybersecurity Project Manager
description:
The Project Manager in our cybersecurity/IT services division will lead the planning and execution of complex technology projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget . This role acts as a bridge between technical teams (network/security engineers, developers, analysts) and business stakeholders. The Project Manager is responsible for coordinating cross-functional efforts in a dynamic environment, often managing multiple projects or client engagements simultaneously, aligning them with strategic goals and the latest industry practices (e.g., Agile methodology, cloud deployments, security compliance ).

Key Responsibilities:

  • Project Planning & Execution: Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables for cybersecurity and IT infrastructure projects. Develop detailed project plans with timelines, milestones, and resource allocation. Manage the full project lifecycle from initiation to closure, adapting to changing requirements or priorities.
  • Team Leadership & Coordination: Lead cross-functional teams (security engineers, IT staff, developers, client representatives) to ensure collaboration and timely task completion. Assign responsibilities, oversee day-to-day project activities, and maintain team motivation and productivity in both on-site and remote/hybrid work environments .
  • Budget & Risk Management: Manage project budgets and control costs. Identify and mitigate risks and issues proactively; implement contingency plans to address potential project roadblocks or security concerns. Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards and regulations (e.g., data privacy laws, security policies) throughout project execution.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary contact for internal and external stakeholders. Provide regular project status updates, performance metrics, and risk assessments to clients, senior management, and team members. Facilitate meetings, gather feedback, and manage expectations to maintain alignment with project goals and client needs.
  • Quality Assurance & Delivery: Ensure project deliverables meet the required quality and security standards. Coordinate testing, user acceptance, and security reviews on project outputs (e.g., new system implementations, policy rollouts). Oversee documentation (project plans, reports, compliance evidence) and obtain stakeholder sign-offs.
  • Post-Project Support & Continuous Improvement: Oversee transition of completed projects to operational teams. Conduct post-mortems and lessons-learned sessions to identify improvement opportunities. Stay informed on emerging industry trends (like AI integration in project management , DevSecOps , and new collaboration tools ) to continually enhance project management practices.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education & Professional Knowledge: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business (or related field). Strong understanding of IT systems, networks, and cybersecurity fundamentals to effectively communicate with technical teams and align projects with security best practices.
  • Project Management Skills: Proven ability to manage complex IT or security projects using project management methodologies (Waterfall and Agile). Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, or Trello) for planning, tracking, and reporting. Skilled in developing project documentation and managing project scope changes.
  • Leadership & Communication: Excellent leadership and organizational skills. Demonstrated experience coordinating cross-functional teams , managing resources, and resolving conflicts. Exceptional communication skills to interface with diverse stakeholders and present project updates in a clear, concise manner.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving: Strong risk assessment, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Capacity to anticipate challenges, craft mitigation strategies, and adapt to evolving project needs. Must be detail-oriented but also able to see the big picture to ensure projects deliver strategic value.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced Knowledge: Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and regulatory standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) to integrate compliance into project plans. Understanding of modern IT trends such as cloud computing projects, digital transformation , or AI-driven solutions is a plus.
  • Industry Experience: Prior experience in an IT services or consulting environment , managing projects for external clients or within large enterprise settings. Background in network/security infrastructure projects or software development projects is advantageous.
  • Methodologies: Certifications or hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies (e.g., Certified Scrum Master) or DevOps/DevSecOps practices.

Experience Requirements:

  • Experience: 7+ years of experience in project management within the IT or cybersecurity domain. This should include successfully managing multiple full project lifecycles , with at least several projects related to IT security, networking, or software/IT infrastructure . Leadership experience in a matrixed or cross-functional team environment is essential.

Certifications:

  • Project Management Certifications: Project Management Professional (PMP) or PRINCE2 (highly preferred / required) as evidence of formal project management training and expertise.
  • Security/Technical Certifications: Certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) , Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) , or Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) are a plus, signifying an understanding of cybersecurity principles and compliance.
  • Agile/Other Certs: Additional certifications like Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or ITIL Foundation are beneficial and reflect a commitment to industry best practices.

title: Analista de Portfólio e Interdependências Sênior (Agile Flow)
description:
Ser o dono da agenda de interdependências do portfólio, atuando end-to-end do início do planejamento até o fechamento do quarter: identificar, priorizar e destravar dependências e bloqueios entre iniciativas, squads e tribos (incluindo entre empresas do grupo), garantindo decisões rápidas e execução até a conclusão. É uma função de puxar e cobrar: articular áreas técnicas e corporativas e, quando necessário, acionar lideranças e executivos para remover impedimentos.


Responsabilidades:


  • Construir e manter o Mapa Único de Interdependências do portfólio (origem, destino, tipo, owner, prazo, risco, status, próxima ação), garantindo visibilidade e foco nas dependências críticas;
  • Atuar como “destravador”: conduzir negociações, alinhar prioridades e remover bloqueios que impedem iniciativas de avançar (capacidade, arquitetura, dados, segurança, fornecedores, etc.);
  • Conduzir uma cadência semanal de decisão e destravamento com agile coachs/AMs/POs/lideranças, garantindo decisão, dono e prazo (não apenas status);
  • Fazer follow-up ativo e cobrança dos responsáveis: acompanhar até fechar, registrar pendências e manter rastreabilidade do que foi acordado;
  • Escalar rapidamente dependências travadas para o nível correto, preparando síntese executiva (contexto, impacto no quarter, opções e recomendação) e puxando os decisores para destravar;
  • Antecipar dependências: atuar antes do “incêndio”, conectando-se aos ciclos de planejamento (mensal/quarter) para evitar surpresas;
  • Produzir comunicação executiva (quinzenal/mensal): top bloqueios, decisões pendentes, gargalos recorrentes, ações e impactos.


Requisitos:


Hard skills:


  • Experiência em gestão de portfólio , PMO , Portfolio Ops ou Delivery Ops em ambientes corporativos complexos e/ou multinacionais, envolvendo múltiplos times, stakeholders e governança estruturada;
  • Vivência prática em gerenciar e destravar interdependências , incluindo priorização, negociação, definição de owners, análise de riscos, gestão de prazos e escalonamento;
  • Capacidade de conduzir fóruns de decisão e rituais de governança (quinzenais, mensais ou trimestrais), com foco em pautas objetivas, registro de decisões, definição de responsáveis e follow-up;
  • Influência sem autoridade e habilidade de negociação com áreas técnicas, corporativas e de negócio;
  • Conhecimento prático de fluxo e previsibilidade (WIP, itens bloqueados, aging, lead/cycle time, throughput) para orientar decisões de priorização, riscos e capacidade;
  • Vivência em ambientes ágeis (squads/tribos) atuando como Agile Coach, Agile Master ou Product Owner, apoiando cadências de planejamento/execução e facilitando acordos entre times para destravar dependências;
  • Conhecimento de práticas de VMO (Value Management Office) , apoiando a priorização e governança de portfólio com base em valor, impacto, risco e capacidade;
  • Domínio de ferramentas como Jira , Azure DevOps , Confluence , SharePoint , Teams , Excel e PowerPoint . Power BI como diferencial.



Soft skills:


  • Protagonismo e mão na massa: puxa a agenda, cobra, destrava;
  • Influência sem autoridade e habilidade de negociar com áreas e lideranças;
  • Comunicação executiva (síntese, clareza, objetividade, opção + recomendação);
  • Resiliência e firmeza para lidar com conflitos e pressões do quarter;
  • Organização e disciplina de follow-up (fechar pendências, não deixar nada “morrer”);
  • Postura de dono: responsabilidade por garantir que bloqueios sejam removidos.

title: Cybersecurity Project Manager
description:
The Project Manager in our cybersecurity/IT services division will lead the planning and execution of complex technology projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget . This role acts as a bridge between technical teams (network/security engineers, developers, analysts) and business stakeholders. The Project Manager is responsible for coordinating cross-functional efforts in a dynamic environment, often managing multiple projects or client engagements simultaneously, aligning them with strategic goals and the latest industry practices (e.g., Agile methodology, cloud deployments, security compliance ).

Key Responsibilities:

  • Project Planning & Execution: Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables for cybersecurity and IT infrastructure projects. Develop detailed project plans with timelines, milestones, and resource allocation. Manage the full project lifecycle from initiation to closure, adapting to changing requirements or priorities.
  • Team Leadership & Coordination: Lead cross-functional teams (security engineers, IT staff, developers, client representatives) to ensure collaboration and timely task completion. Assign responsibilities, oversee day-to-day project activities, and maintain team motivation and productivity in both on-site and remote/hybrid work environments .
  • Budget & Risk Management: Manage project budgets and control costs. Identify and mitigate risks and issues proactively; implement contingency plans to address potential project roadblocks or security concerns. Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards and regulations (e.g., data privacy laws, security policies) throughout project execution.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary contact for internal and external stakeholders. Provide regular project status updates, performance metrics, and risk assessments to clients, senior management, and team members. Facilitate meetings, gather feedback, and manage expectations to maintain alignment with project goals and client needs.
  • Quality Assurance & Delivery: Ensure project deliverables meet the required quality and security standards. Coordinate testing, user acceptance, and security reviews on project outputs (e.g., new system implementations, policy rollouts). Oversee documentation (project plans, reports, compliance evidence) and obtain stakeholder sign-offs.
  • Post-Project Support & Continuous Improvement: Oversee transition of completed projects to operational teams. Conduct post-mortems and lessons-learned sessions to identify improvement opportunities. Stay informed on emerging industry trends (like AI integration in project management , DevSecOps , and new collaboration tools ) to continually enhance project management practices.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education & Professional Knowledge: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business (or related field). Strong understanding of IT systems, networks, and cybersecurity fundamentals to effectively communicate with technical teams and align projects with security best practices.
  • Project Management Skills: Proven ability to manage complex IT or security projects using project management methodologies (Waterfall and Agile). Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, or Trello) for planning, tracking, and reporting. Skilled in developing project documentation and managing project scope changes.
  • Leadership & Communication: Excellent leadership and organizational skills. Demonstrated experience coordinating cross-functional teams , managing resources, and resolving conflicts. Exceptional communication skills to interface with diverse stakeholders and present project updates in a clear, concise manner.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving: Strong risk assessment, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Capacity to anticipate challenges, craft mitigation strategies, and adapt to evolving project needs. Must be detail-oriented but also able to see the big picture to ensure projects deliver strategic value.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced Knowledge: Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and regulatory standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) to integrate compliance into project plans. Understanding of modern IT trends such as cloud computing projects, digital transformation , or AI-driven solutions is a plus.
  • Industry Experience: Prior experience in an IT services or consulting environment , managing projects for external clients or within large enterprise settings. Background in network/security infrastructure projects or software development projects is advantageous.
  • Methodologies: Certifications or hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies (e.g., Certified Scrum Master) or DevOps/DevSecOps practices.

Experience Requirements:

  • Experience: 7+ years of experience in project management within the IT or cybersecurity domain. This should include successfully managing multiple full project lifecycles , with at least several projects related to IT security, networking, or software/IT infrastructure . Leadership experience in a matrixed or cross-functional team environment is essential.

Certifications:

  • Project Management Certifications: Project Management Professional (PMP) or PRINCE2 (highly preferred / required) as evidence of formal project management training and expertise.
  • Security/Technical Certifications: Certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) , Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) , or Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) are a plus, signifying an understanding of cybersecurity principles and compliance.
  • Agile/Other Certs: Additional certifications like Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or ITIL Foundation are beneficial and reflect a commitment to industry best practices.
